description: The venue seating chart for one event, as an image -- 'where is section 104?', 'show me the map'. It is the venue layout, showing where each section sits in the building, and not a photograph of the view from a seat. Some venues have no chart; the section and row from get_ticket_listings still identify the seats. event_id comes from search_events, search_market or get_event_details. No sign-in needed.

event_id.description: Event identifier from search_market, search_events or get_event_details.
